extra_vocab.en: gets or earns something good, like a contract, a game, or support
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 wins 是第三人稱單數動詞，和 over 組成 wins over（爭取到…的支持）。句中的 magnetic 是「有魅力的」，剛好呼應本篇的「磁鐵」主題。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: that 引導的關係子句裡，動詞要和先行詞 personality（單數）一致，所以用 wins，不是 win。

example.en: Our team won the contract after the final presentation.
example.zh: 最後簡報之後，我們的團隊拿下了合約。

example.en: We are winning more customers since we lowered our prices.
example.zh: 自從我們降價之後，贏得了更多客戶。

example.en: A winning bid usually offers the best price and service.
example.zh: 得標的報價通常提供了最好的價格和服務。

example.en: Three companies are competing to win the contract.
example.zh: 有三家公司正在競爭這份合約。

example.en: Our stroller could win an award at the trade fair.
example.zh: 我們的推車有機會在貿易展上得獎。

example.en: Honest service helps us win the trust of new customers.
example.zh: 誠實的服務幫助我們贏得新客戶的信任。

examples.en: Our lower price wins us many new orders every month.
examples.zh: 我們較低的價格讓我們每個月贏得許多新訂單。

examples.en: The sales team wins the quarterly award almost every year.
examples.zh: 這個業務團隊幾乎每年都拿下季度獎項。

examples.en: A clear demo often wins the support of cautious managers.
examples.zh: 清楚的示範常能爭取到謹慎主管的支持。

confusable.diff: winds 是 wind（風）的複數，發音是 /wɪndz/，拼法和 wins 只差一個 d。

example.en: Strong winds delayed the shipment by two days.
example.zh: 強風使貨物延誤了兩天。

similar.diff: earns 強調靠努力或表現「換來」信任、尊重或薪水；wins 強調在競爭中爭取到。

example.en: She earns the trust of every client she meets.
example.zh: 她贏得了每位見過的客戶的信任。

similar.diff: gains 是「逐漸獲得」，語氣較中性，常接經驗、優勢、市占。

example.en: The company gains a larger market share each year.
example.zh: 這家公司每年都獲得更大的市占率。

example.en: We hope to achieve our sales goal by December.
example.zh: 我們希望在十二月前達成銷售目標。

example.en: The design team received an award for safety.
example.zh: 設計團隊因安全設計而獲獎。

example.en: We hope to win the supplier contract next month.
example.zh: 我們希望下個月能拿下供應商合約。

example.en: The new client was a big win for our sales team.
example.zh: 這位新客戶對我們的業務團隊是一大勝利。

senses.en: to get people to like you or agree with you

example.en: A fair price can win the support of local buyers.
example.zh: 公平的價格可以爭取到當地買家的支持。

senses.en: to be the best in a game or a competition
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 support、trust、customer 時指爭取；受詞是 bid、game、prize 時指在比賽中勝出。

example.en: Our company won the bid to supply the airline.
example.zh: 我們公司贏得了供應航空公司的標案。

extra_vocab.en: makes someone like you or agree with you
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡指她的魅力能讓每位客戶都站在她這一邊。wins over 帶有「從懷疑變成支持」的語感，常用於業務或簡報情境。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: win over 是可分開的片語動詞：名詞可放中間或後面（win the client over / win over the client），代名詞一定放中間（win him over）。

examples.en: A friendly attitude often wins over difficult customers.
examples.zh: 友善的態度常能爭取到難搞的客戶。

examples.en: The clear demo won over the doubtful committee members.
examples.zh: 清楚的示範說服了心存疑慮的委員。

examples.en: We hope this free trial will win them over.
examples.zh: 我們希望這次免費試用能爭取到他們的支持。

similar.diff: persuade 是較中性的「說服」，常接 persuade 人 to V；win over 強調讓對方改變態度並喜歡你。

example.en: We tried to persuade the buyer to order more units.
example.zh: 我們試著說服買家多訂一些數量。

similar.diff: convince 是讓人「相信」某件事，常接 that 子句或 of；win over 則是爭取對方站在你這邊。

example.en: The test results convinced us that the design is safe.
example.zh: 測試結果讓我們相信這個設計是安全的。

confusable.diff: win back 是「贏回」已經失去的客戶或市場，win over 是爭取原本不支持的人。

example.en: We want to win back customers who left last year.
example.zh: 我們想贏回去年流失的客戶。

extra_vocab.en: to pass a card through a reader, or to move your finger across a screen
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 swipe 是祈使句中的動詞，請人把磁卡在讀卡機上刷過去；magnetic card 也呼應本篇的磁鐵主題。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: swipe 的受詞是卡片：swipe a card through the reader，不要把讀卡機當成受詞。

example.en: Each employee swipes a badge to enter the building.
example.zh: 每位員工都刷識別證進入大樓。

example.en: The customer swiped his card, but the payment failed.
example.zh: 客人刷了卡，但付款失敗了。

example.en: Swiping the card too slowly may cause a reading error.
example.zh: 刷卡太慢可能會造成讀取錯誤。

example.en: Please swipe a card at the entrance to record your time.
example.zh: 請在入口處刷卡記錄你的時間。

example.en: Swipe the screen to see more product photos.
example.zh: 滑動螢幕就能看到更多產品照片。

example.en: Swipe to unlock the tablet before starting the demo.
example.zh: 開始示範之前，請先滑動解鎖平板。

examples.en: Please swipe your magnetic card at the door reader.
examples.zh: 請在門口讀卡機上刷你的磁卡。

examples.en: You can swipe or insert your card at the payment machine.
examples.zh: 你可以在刷卡機上刷卡或插卡。

confusable.diff: wipe 是「擦拭」，拼法只差一個 s；swipe 是刷過或滑過。

example.en: Please wipe the screen before the customer arrives.
example.zh: 客人到達之前，請先擦乾淨螢幕。

confusable.diff: swap 是「交換、替換」，拼法相近但和刷卡動作無關。

example.en: Can we swap the meeting time with the call?
example.zh: 我們可以把會議和電話會議的時間對調嗎？

similar.diff: scan 是用機器「掃描」條碼或證件，通常不需要刷過讀卡槽。

example.en: Staff scan each ticket at the entrance gate.
example.zh: 工作人員在入口閘門掃描每張票。

similar.diff: tap 是「輕觸」感應，多用於感應式付款或觸控；swipe 是劃過去。

example.en: Customers can tap their phones to pay for coffee.
example.zh: 客人可以用手機輕觸感應來付咖啡錢。

example.en: Visitors must wear a badge inside the factory.
example.zh: 訪客在工廠內必須配戴識別證。

example.en: Only managers have access to the storage room.
example.zh: 只有主管能進入儲藏室。

example.en: The card reader at the front desk is not working.
example.zh: 櫃台的讀卡機壞了。

example.en: Swipe your card through the reader and wait for the light.
example.zh: 把卡片從讀卡機刷過去，然後等燈亮。

example.en: One quick swipe is enough to unlock the door.
example.zh: 快速刷一下就足以開門。

senses.en: to pass a card through a reader

example.en: Staff must swipe their cards when they leave the office.
example.zh: 員工離開辦公室時必須刷卡。

senses.en: to move your finger across a touch screen
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 card 時指刷卡；受詞是 screen、photo 或後面接 left / right 時指用手指滑動。

example.en: Swipe left to delete an item from the shopping list.
example.zh: 向左滑動即可刪除購物清單上的項目。

extra_vocab.en: a short time when someone or something is tested before a final decision
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡指新員工的試用期：公司在試用期結束後，才提供她正式的工作。商務上也可指產品或服務的試用階段。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 試用期「期間」用 during the trial period，「結束之後」用 after；表示長度時 month 用單數：a three-month trial period。

examples.en: New employees must pass a three-month trial period.
examples.zh: 新進員工必須通過三個月的試用期。

examples.en: The trial period for the software ends on Friday.
examples.zh: 這套軟體的試用期在星期五結束。

examples.en: We will test the machine during the trial period before buying.
examples.zh: 購買之前，我們會在試用期間先測試這台機器。

similar.diff: probation period 多指新員工的「試用期」，語氣較正式；trial period 也可用於產品或服務。

example.en: She received a full contract after her probation period.
example.zh: 試用期結束後，她拿到了正式合約。

similar.diff: free trial 是「免費試用」，多用於產品或訂閱服務，強調不用付費。

example.en: Customers can start a free trial of the app today.
example.zh: 客戶今天就可以開始免費試用這個應用程式。

confusable.diff: grace period 是「寬限期」，指逾期後仍可補繳或補辦的時間；trial period 是用來測試或觀察的時間。

example.en: We offer a ten-day grace period for late payments.
example.zh: 對於逾期付款，我們提供十天的寬限期。
